connections.posting.limits.line: These limits are for this business; posts from every business on this computer count toward them. Chausar's own limits are the loosest it posts at, and you can only make them stricter. An empty box means Chausar's own.

connections.posting.limits.duplicatePerc: Hold a post this percent like a recent one
connections.posting.limits.linkStreak: Warn at this many posts in a row linking one site
connections.posting.limits.saved: Saved. These limits apply to the next post.

connections.ai.title: Your AI
connections.ai.draft: No business is open yet, so this AI drafts your first plan.
connections.ai.spendNote: You pay the AI company directly. Chausar sets the cost aside before each call and refuses a call with no known price.
connections.ai.sendNothing: Your privacy setting sends nothing to AI, so every call is stopped.
connections.ai.replay: Answers come from a synthetic recording.
connections.ai.recommendedLine: One Anthropic key: Haiku for quick work, Sonnet for plans and drafts.

connections.bankSheet.noAccounts: No accounts yet. Import a statement to add one.
connections.bankSheet.consentNone: No bank access given. Statements you import still work.
connections.bankSheet.addressHint: Only the number of new alerts goes there. Leave it empty to keep the address you set.
connections.bankSheet.noOpenInvoices: No open invoices to match this to.

connections.transcribe.hint: Uses a whisper.cpp already on this computer. Chausar never installs it or downloads a model.

connections.transcribe.modelHint: The full path to the model you downloaded yourself, for example C:\whisper.cpp\models\ggml-base.bin

connections.network.title: Your network
connections.network.line: Your own files, read on this computer. Nothing is fetched.
connections.mailbox.title: Your mailbox
connections.mailbox.line: Chausar reads replies from people in your network and pipeline, read-only. It never sends mail or marks it read.
connections.mailbox.desktopOnly: Connect your mailbox in the desktop app. It reads your mail on your computer.
connections.mailbox.disconnect.ask: Chausar stops reading this mailbox and forgets the app password. Mail it already read stays with your pipeline.
connections.mailbox.passwordHint: Make one in your mail account's security settings. Chausar keeps it only while the app is open.
connections.mailbox.oauth: An account that allows only Google or Microsoft sign-in can't connect this way. Record replies by hand instead.
connections.mailbox.calendar.title: Your calendar
connections.mailbox.calendar.line: Chausar reads its private address each morning for calls with people you know.
connections.mailbox.calendar.desktopOnly: Set your calendar address in the desktop app. It reads your calendar on your computer.
connections.mailbox.calendar.urlHint: The address that ends in .ics. Chausar keeps it only while the app is open.
